describes: Muslim MLAs by state / UT legislative assembly, most recent election per assembly (2020-2026 cycle), plus the all-states national aggregate: muslim_seats, total_seats and the compilation cited per row.
compilation_note: Religion of MLAs is not tabulated in any single official publication. Each row is cross-verified across journalistic compilations (Maktoob, Clarion India, The India Forum, The Wire, Deccan Herald, FACTLY, Outlook, Radiance Weekly, ummid.com and others); the citing source is in the citation column. The national-aggregate row carries no count (empty seats, ~6% share). This committed, diffable table is the archived L1 the mla-share canonicaliser reads.
